title: Day 963: IDF Kills Mohammed Odeh — Hamas Al-Qassam Brigades Commander and October 7 Architect — in Gaza City Airstrike on Eid al-Adha; 11 Days After Killing His Predecessor Haddad
detail: On May 27, 2026 (Day 963 / Ceasefire Day 230 / Eid al-Adha), Israeli forces struck and killed Mohammed Odeh — the newly appointed commander of Hamas's Al-Qassam Brigades military wing — in an airstrike on the Rimal neighborhood of Gaza City. Odeh, who had been appointed on May 18, 2026 to replace Izz al-Din al-Haddad (killed by Israel on May 15–16, 2026), was killed just 9 days after his appointment — 11 days after his predecessor's death. Six people were killed in the strike, including Odeh's wife, two sons, and daughter. The IDF stated that Odeh was 'one of the last senior commanders in Hamas's military wing who took part in the planning and execution of the October 7 massacre.' Odeh previously served as Hamas's military intelligence chief and was a member of the Hamas Supreme Military Council during the planning and execution of Operation Al-Aqsa Flood on October 7, 2023. His assassination represents a direct continuation of the NILI task force campaign (revealed by the Wall Street Journal on May 21–22, 2026) — the secret Shin Bet/Mossad joint operation maintaining a comprehensive kill-or-capture list of all approximately 3,000 October 7 participants. Prime Minister Netanyahu confirmed the strike in a public statement, declaring: 'Any one who harmed Israeli citizens — we will get to him. Anyone who takes the role of harming Israelis — we will get to him as well.' Defense Minister Israel Katz similarly reaffirmed the commitment to pursue every October 7 perpetrator regardless of their current role. Hamas confirmed Odeh's death and issued a statement vowing to appoint a new commander. The killing came on Eid al-Adha — a significant Islamic holiday marking the end of the Hajj pilgrimage — and drew immediate international attention. Al Jazeera noted the strike underscores Israel's continued willingness to conduct targeted operations during major Islamic holidays. Odeh's elimination continues Israel's systematic elimination of all known senior October 7 architects: Sinwar (Oct 16, 2024), Shambari (Apr 29, 2026), Haddad (May 16, 2026), and now Odeh — the fourth senior architect eliminated in 2026. Phase Two ceasefire negotiations remain in total deadlock. 35 days remain until the Israeli Supreme Court's July 1, 2026 accountability deadline.

title: Day 963: 35 Days to Supreme Court July 1 Accountability Deadline — Knesset Kallner Bill First Plenum Reading Expected This Week; Netanyahu Reaffirms NILI Campaign After Odeh Killing
detail: On May 27, 2026 (Day 963 / Ceasefire Day 230), the October 7 accountability crisis entered its 35-day countdown to the Israeli Supreme Court's July 1, 2026 constitutional deadline for the government to present a credible investigation framework. Following the IDF's killing of Mohammed Odeh — Hamas military wing commander and October 7 architect — in Gaza City's Rimal neighborhood, Prime Minister Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz issued statements reaffirming Israel's commitment to pursuing every October 7 perpetrator. The statements served dual political purposes: affirming the NILI task force campaign's effectiveness while deflecting from the escalating constitutional pressure around the accountability deadline. The Knesset coalition's Kallner inquiry bill was expected for its first full Knesset plenum reading in the final week of May 2026. If passed in first reading, the bill advances to its second and third readings; opposition parties have already pledged an immediate Supreme Court challenge, arguing the bill's weakened language and 'no judges' clause make it incompatible with the High Court's minimum standards for an acceptable investigation framework. Bereaved families' organizations and the Hostages and Missing Families Forum continued to press for a genuine independent state commission, with the October Council forum maintaining weekly protests outside the Prime Minister's residence in Jerusalem. The Beyachad alliance (Naftali Bennett + Yair Lapid) polled as the leading opposition alternative, with an independent October 7 state commission as their pledged Day 1 governing priority. Phase Two of the Gaza ceasefire (Hamas disarmament + Israeli withdrawal) remained in total deadlock for the 230th day of the ceasefire. 2,400+ IDF-documented violations; 857+ Palestinians killed since the October 10, 2025 ceasefire began.

media.caption: Washington Post May 27 — Israel kills Hamas military chief Odeh on Eid al-Adha; 35 days to Supreme Court July 1 accountability deadline
